snippet.title: Beneath Paris | Demo Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The wait is over. Beneath Paris, a psychological horror game set in the catacombs beneath the city, is getting a free demo, and the release date is finally here.

Descend into the forbidden French Catacombs in this atmospheric first person horror experience. Explore restricted tunnels, uncover hidden secrets, and venture deeper into forgotten passages where the further you go, the more it feels like something is down there with you.

🕯️ Demo Release Date: 30/09/2026
🎮 Demo page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4782760/Beneath_Paris_Demo/
🎵 Original score by Rivilin

Wishlist the demo now and get ready to descend.

#BeneathParis #IndieHorrorGame
